reviews.text: I will not use anyone but Dr. Rudy Zamora, and believe me, as a cat owner for many many years and a foster and rescuer, I've been to them all. He is the BEST. I hesitate to leave this review because I don't want him getting too full up that he can't take me. The phone receptionists are also good and professional (I've come across some real doozies in my day) and Duncan especially is always unfailingly polite. This is a tough job—people call and can be extremely upset because their best friend/pet child is sick or they can't afford the admittedly ridiculously high prices to care for their fur baby. It takes a special kind of person to man the phones at a vet office. Duncan IS that person! I hope he is well compensated. (I'm quite shocked at the person below who put Dr. Zamora's picture on here and blamed him for her cat's death despite clearly stating in the review that when her cat began vomiting she did not take him to a vet!! And then took her cat here for euthanasia?? The stuff vets have to go through is insane.)

One of the best vet practices there is! All the doctors are so caring, knowledgeable, and helpful. Really grateful for the amazing techs and assistants too, who are always lovely and kind. We have other vet practices closer to our new apartment but will continue bringing our cats here since the care is unparalleled.

My cat had dental surgery and it went well even though he's 12 years old. The doctors and staff are knowledgeable and compassionate. I feel comfortable with how well they treated my cat because he felt at ease with them.

The worst phone support. Christina specifically. Trying to get my dog’s prescription which is time sensitive and she’s just trying to rush me off the phone. “So, to confirm, that’s 150mg?” “Yep, 100mg. We’ll give you a call.” Since when are those the same?? She barely listens and constantly having to correct her is exhausting. We have loved seeing our actual vet get (Dr. Grillo) but the front desk staff needs to either get their shit together or they need to hire actually competent employees. Exhausting on an already stressful day. When asked to have my dog’s prescription called in today, she said, “I’ll try my best.” It’s 10am. How are you not able to guarantee that you’ll call it in over the next 8 hours you’re open?? We will be changing vets. The communication here is too frustrating.
I love Greenwood Vet! They have been amazing with my two rescue dogs and I trust them implicitly. They are kind, caring and know their stuff. I would highly recommend them!
Only people I trust with my dog
They got my 2 cats in quickly and were so sweet and understanding to my scared little guys. They were kind, helpful, patient, informative, and thorough. 1000/10

I recently switched to Greenwood Veterinary Care on a friend’s recommendation and I’m really glad I did! My cat sees Dr. Grillo, who I can see is as enamored by her as I am– which puts me at ease having her under his care.

I never feel rushed or judged by Dr. Grillo or the rest of the team, which I am grateful for. The office is clean, the staff is professional, and my anxious cat seems to be as comfortable as she can possibly be in a vet’s office.

I’ve been bringing my cat to this clinic for about six years. For routine annual checkups, vaccines, and basic care, the clinic has generally been fine. Some doctors and staff have been very good and compassionate over the years.

However, my most recent experience was extremely disappointing and concerning.

I brought my cat in because he had stopped eating for several days. Bloodwork and tests were performed ($400), but the only treatment initially provided was antibiotics. I was told the doctor would call me the next day with the blood test results. He did call, but I missed the call. No voicemail was left.

I called the clinic back asking to speak with the doctor and asking for the blood test results to be emailed to me because I was considering taking my cat to the emergency room and wanted to avoid paying to repeat the same tests. I was told someone would call me back or send the results, but nobody ever followed up and the results were never sent.

As a result, I ended up going to the emergency hospital and paying again for additional bloodwork and diagnostics.

Communication was the biggest issue throughout the experience. The doctor I most commonly saw these years often avoids eye contact, gave very minimal explanations, and would abruptly leave the room without clearly explaining next steps or whether he would return.

Unfortunately, my cat was later diagnosed at the emergency hospital with a terminal disease and passed away shortly afterward.

I understand not every illness can be diagnosed immediately, but timely communication, follow-up, and basic responsiveness matter deeply, especially in serious cases.

Based on my experience, I would consider this clinic acceptable for routine wellness visits, but I would personally seek more proactive and communicative care for anything more serious.
I love everyone who works at Greenwood Veterinary Care. The entire staff is wonderful!  I have an elderly dog, so we spend quite a bit of time at the vet. I have never had a bad experience.
Great Vet!  We love Dr. Z and all the staff.
It was very informative.  They treated me with respect and affection..my dog lola was given the utmost support and attention.. I'll recommend this vet to everyone..

Came here based on a friend’s recommendation and the strong reviews, so I had high expectations. The actual visit itself was great.  The doctor and team were welcoming, attentive, and helpful, and we left feeling confident in the care provided.

Unfortunately, everything after that hasn’t matched the same standard. We’ve been waiting over three weeks for results from a simple blood test and still haven’t received them, despite back-and-forth calls trying to follow up. The lack of timely communication and resolution has been frustrating and not what I expected based on prior recommendations. Hoping this is something that can be improved.

UPDATE: The doctor did eventually reach out, we received the results, and they were very thorough in walking through everything and answering all of my questions. I appreciated the time and care taken during that conversation.

Overall, a positive clinical experience, but the post-visit communication could be improved.
The front desk is always super helpful and they can answer questions over the phone most of the time which is really great. The doctors there are also great and trustworthy.

Dr. Zamora was informative and attentive, and the vet techs were friendly during our visit. However, the front desk communication and intake process felt very disorganized.

Before the appointment, I called to schedule visits for both of my cats and provided all of their information over the phone specifically mentioned that one of my cats was due for a 3-year rabies vaccine. I also emailed their prior medical records so they should know all their information already.

When I arrived, I was asked to complete paperwork that repeated much of the same information I had already provided by phone and email. While I was in the exam room, the technician was also asking me many of the same questions again to fill out the cats’ profiles, and some information had apparently been entered incorrectly from my earlier call. For example I was asked to clarify if my cats were 5 days old and 3 days old when they were 5 years old and 3 years old due to the information being entered incorrectly and it was so silly to be asked to clarify several times the “days” part because if you look at them, they’re clearly adult cats and not days year old cats. It was confusing to be answering questions verbally while also filling out a form asking for the same details.

The bigger issue was learning at the time of the appointment that the clinic only stocks the 1-year rabies vaccine. I had specifically mentioned wanting the 3-year vaccine when I scheduled the appointment. If the clinic does not carry that vaccine, it would have been helpful to know beforehand so I could make an informed decision before bringing my cats in.

Overall, the staff were nice, but the front desk communication and intake process could be more streamlined and transparent to avoid repeating information multiple times and to clarify vaccine options ahead of the visit.
